name: create-deal
description: Creates a HubSpot deal in a pipeline stage (the stage and pipeline ids from hubspot__list-pipelines), with an optional amount, close date and owner (an id from hubspot__list-owners), optionally associated with a contact (an id from hubspot__find-contact) and a company (an id from hubspot__get-record).

pipelineId.description: A pipeline ID from hubspot__list-pipelines. Defaults to default.

closeDate.description: The close date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

contactId.description: A contact ID from hubspot__find-contact or hubspot__get-record to associate with the deal.

companyId.description: A company id to associate the deal with, from the associations hubspot__get-record answers.
